title: In bulk mode the actions menu offers only Export
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ONLYEXP-01) is active at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  6. Click Export.
  7. Click the X at the right end of the bar.
  8. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The menu holds a single entry, "Export". "Cycle count" and "Deactivate parts" are not offered.
  • Step 6: A file downloads, and bulk mode stays on.
  • Step 8: With bulk mode ended, the menu again lists "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S2-R10b, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.8 (Branch: the menu while the mode is on), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R10b: “While the mode is on, the actions menu offers only Export. Cycle count and the bulk entry come back when the mode ends.”
